name: Soulmonsters Battle Ink v1
references: User battle HUD sketches provided 2026-10-26; primary: colored action cards and creature portraits; secondary: ink cut-in and round badge
scope: Native Godot battle UI. Runtime text, bars, bindings, costs and input remain independent.

brush-clusters-v2.png.brief: Four isolated black manga ink swashes with white scratch marks, 2x2 layout, transparent background; refined to remove haze.
brush-clusters-v2.png.slicing: Four AtlasTexture quadrants, fixed aspect ratio. Original raster preserved.
brush-clusters-v2.png.validation: Alpha inspected; ornamental overlay checked on real blue sky and colored cards. Not used as a stretched whole-panel background.

icon-*.svg.source: Original editable silhouette paths written for these action identities.

portrait-regions.json.source: Alpha bounds from existing approved combat idle frames; no new creature design

sprite-bounds.json.source: Union of alpha extents across all existing combat animation frames; shared crop stabilizes frame origin
sprite-bounds.json.note: Runtime fit preserves aspect ratio and uses existing real animation frames. No collision/damage changes.

veredas-arena-wide-v2.png.brief: Open courtyard, broad visible stone floor, low forest-ruin horizon and clear sky, matching the supplied composition reference.
veredas-arena-wide-v2.png.role: Battle background, no baked HUD, characters or text
veredas-arena-wide-v2.png.validation: Inspected source image and in-engine rendering.

rooftop-arena-wide-v2.png.brief: Rooftop variant with terrace floor beginning at approximately 55 percent height; simple skyline and quiet sky.
rooftop-arena-wide-v2.png.role: Battle background, no baked HUD, characters or text
rooftop-arena-wide-v2.png.validation: Inspected source image and in-engine rendering.

foreground-veredas-v1.png.brief: Dark teal opaque foliage and rocks, transparent empty middle/top, wide 3:1 foreground strip; tall side clusters and low center.
foreground-veredas-v1.png.role: Foreground decoration behind controls; left/right proportional caps and repeated low center region. No collisions or input.

card-ripped-v2.svg.role: Ripped card face; colored by material, separate selection burst, labels and keycap.

validation.scope: Rendered snapshots include pause, low energy, results, failed save, boss intro, long names and actual windup state fixtures.

revision_wide_arena.projection: Separate screen X/Y field projection, proportional sprite compensation. Effects use the same position projection; text remains in HUD space. Logical rules, limits, saves and hit tests unchanged.
revision_wide_arena.flight_reserve: 192 UI units below status, 240 for three-player round header. Anchors terminate 30 UI units above cards.
revision_wide_arena.selection: Coral/white jagged burst and pale caption band. Only the selected command gets the persistent burst.
